title: ఉప్పులూరి గోపాలకృష్ణ మూర్తి (Telugu Wikipedia article on U.G. Krishnamurti)
description: Telugu Wikipedia biography (note spelling 'ఉప్పులూరి'): born 9 July 1918 Machilipatnam, died 22 March 2007 Vallecrosia, Italy; raised by grandmother in Gudivada after mother died a week after his birth; lists granddaughter Soumya Bollapragada. Infobox image to be checked on page.

title: ಯು. ಜಿ. ಕೃಷ್ಣಮೂರ್ತಿ (Kannada Wikipedia article on U.G. Krishnamurti)
description: Kannada Wikipedia article: 'ಕೃಷ್ಣಮೂರ್ತಿ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಚಿತರಾಗಿದ್ದ ಉಪ್ಪಲೂರಿ ಗೋಪಾಲ ಕೃಷ್ಣಮೂರ್ತಿ (೯ ಜುಲೈ ೧೯೧೮ - ೨೨ ಮಾರ್ಚ್ ೨೦೦೭)'; describes him as the Indian thinker who questioned enlightenment.

title: యు.జి. కృష్ణమూర్తి గురించి / ఎవరీ యు.జి. కృష్ణమూర్తి (About U.G. Krishnamurti? – Telugu edition)
description: 38-page Telugu introduction to U.G. by J.S. Subrahmanyam (ISBN 9781543160451, CreateSpace 2017). Free PDF 'యు.జి. కృష్ణమూర్తి గురించి (తెలుగు అనువాదం: జె.ఎస్. సుబ్రహ్మణ్యం)' hosted on J.C. Tsai's well.com archive; also sold as ebook 'ఎవరీ యు.జి. కృష్ణమూర్తి' on Pothi. States he was born 9 July 1918 in Machilipatnam into a Telugu Brahmin family and schooled in Gudivada.

title: యు.జి. కృష్ణమూర్తి – ఒక జీవిత కథ (U.G. Krishnamurti – Oka Jeevita Katha; Telugu translation of Mahesh Bhatt's biography)
description: Telugu translation by K. Chandrasekhar of Mahesh Bhatt's 'U.G. Krishnamurti: A Life', published 1994, per J.C. Tsai's bibliography of works on U.G.

title: యు.జి. కృష్ణమూర్తి – జీవితం, దృక్పథం (U.G. Krishnamurti – Jeevitam, Drkpatham; Life and Outlook)
description: Telugu book on U.G. by the noted Telugu writer Abburi Chayadevi, published by C.P. Brown Academy, Hyderabad, 2011, per J.C. Tsai's bibliography.

title: యు.జి. కృష్ణమూర్తి – జీవితం, తత్వం (U.G. Krishnamurti – Life and Philosophy, by Sarvari)
description: Telugu book on U.G. by Sarvari, published by Master Yogashram, Secunderabad, 2008, per J.C. Tsai's bibliography.

title: Stopped in Our Tracks: Stories of U.G. in India – from the Telugu notebooks of K. Chandrasekhar
description: English series 'translated from the Telugu and edited by J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty' from K. Chandrasekhar's Telugu notebooks and audio tapes; Series 1 Smriti Books, New Delhi 2005 (ISBN 9788188043637), Series 2 ('UG – Anecdotes, Comments and Reflections') The Firsthand Publications, Bangalore; later Winsome Books India 2009. Full text on Wikisource; Series 2 scan on Scribd. Telugu originals' own titles/dates not located online.

title: ಇಲ್ಲಿ ವಾದವಿಲ್ಲ – ಇರುವುದೆಲ್ಲಾ ವೇದ (Illi Vadavilla – Iruvudella Veda; Kannada translation of 'Conversations', first book on U.G.)
description: The first publication on U.G. (1978): Kannada translation of the 'Conversations' booklet, translated by B.A. Ranganath; released in Mysore at Dr. K.B. Ramakrishna Rao's house on his 60th birthday, per ugkrishnamurti.in key events and J.C. Tsai's bibliography.

title: ಯು.ಜಿ. ಅಲ್ಲ ಗುರೂಜಿ (U.G. Alla Guruji – 'U.G. is not a Guru')
description: Kannada book by Y.N. Krishnamurthy (YNK), editor of Kannada Prabha, published by Akshaya Publications/Akshaya Prakashana, Bangalore, 1995. A 2008 Kannada blog post on YNK's writing also quotes U.G.'s question about life's meaning.

title: யு.ஜி.கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தி புத்தகங்கள் (U.G. Krishnamurti books in Tamil – Panuval author page)
description: Tamil online bookshop Panuval's author listing of Tamil-language U.G. Krishnamurti books.

title: U.G.Krishnamoorthy Books – யு.ஜி.கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தி புத்தகங்கள் (Udumalai.com Tamil listing)
description: Tamil bookshop Udumalai.com's author page listing Tamil U.G. Krishnamurti titles.

title: மனதை ஒரு புனைவு – யு.ஜி. கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தி (Mind is a Myth – Tamil translation, YouTube)
description: YouTube video presenting the Tamil translation of 'Mind is a Myth: Conversations with U.G. Krishnamurti' (மனதை ஒரு புனைவு).

title: यूजी कृष्णमूर्ति (U.G. Krishnamurti – Hindi-titled YouTube episode on his life and philosophy)
description: Hindi-titled YouTube episode described as covering the life and philosophy of Uppaluri Gopala Krishnamurti.

title: U.G.Krishnamurti tag on Kinige (Telugu ebook store)
description: Kinige, the Telugu ebook store, has a tag page for U.G. Krishnamurti, indicating Telugu titles by/about him are sold there (titles not captured in search snippet).

title: दिमाग ही दुश्मन है – यू.जी. कृष्णमूर्ति (Dimag Hi Dushman Hai – Hindi 'Thought Is Your Enemy')
description: Hindi edition of U.G.'s 'Thought Is Your Enemy' listed on a Hindi PDF-books site: 168 pages, 7.42 MB; publisher not stated on the page.

title: ना ख़त्म होनेवाली कहानी (Na Khatm Honewali Kahani – Hindi translation of Mahesh Bhatt's 'U.G. Krishnamurti: A Life')
description: Hindi translation of Mahesh Bhatt's biography published by Vani Prakashan, 1996, per the translations list on ugkrishnamurti.in. Hindi Wikipedia has a stub 'न खत्म होने वाली कहानी' identifying it as Mahesh Bhatt's book.

title: अब मैं कौन हूँ? (Ab Mai Kaun Hun? – Hindi edition of 'A Taste of Death')
description: Hindi edition (1997) of 'A Taste of Death' (Mahesh Bhatt's account of U.G.'s near-death experiences), per the translations list on ugkrishnamurti.in.

title: यूजी कृष्णमूर्ति – अद्वितीय भारतीय विद्रोही दार्शनिक (Outlook Hindi birth-anniversary article)
description: Outlook Hindi special article on U.G.'s birth anniversary describing him as a unique rebel philosopher, 'anti-guru' and spiritual nihilist born in Masulipatnam 1918.

title: यू.जी. कृष्णमूर्ती (Marathi Wikipedia article)
description: Marathi Wikipedia: 'उप्पालुरी गोपाल कृष्णमूर्ती' (9 July 1918 – 22 March 2007), Indian thinker who questioned enlightenment (बोधी); notes he always called his state the 'natural state'.

title: यु.जी. कृष्णमूर्ती: नो वे आऊट! भाग एक (U.G. Krishnamurti: No Way Out! Part 1 – Marathi essay on Maayboli)
description: Multi-part Marathi essay on U.G.'s life and thought on the Marathi community site Maayboli; clarifies he is Uppaluri Gopala Krishnamurti, not Jiddu Krishnamurti, and recounts his meeting with Ramana Maharshi. Same text also posted on Misalpav; the author's earlier U.G.-inspired Marathi pieces are 'माझा दोस्त युजिनी' and 'वाचा आणि शोधा'.

title: யூ.ஜி.கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தியின் பயன் (The Use of U.G. Krishnamurti – Jeyamohan essay/reader letter)
description: Tamil writer Jeyamohan's post comparing U.G. with J. Krishnamurti: 'யூஜி எதையும் தேடவேண்டாம் என்கிறார்' (U.G. says do not seek anything, do not think, do not form opinions).

title: ஞானமடைதல் என்ற புதிர் (Gnanamadaithal Endra Puthir – 'The Puzzle of Attaining Enlightenment', Tamil U.G. book)
description: Tamil U.G. Krishnamurti book published by Kannadasan Pathippagam, price Rs 80; reviewed in a 2013 Tamil reader-experience blog (part 1).

title: யு. ஜி. கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தி: ஒரு வாழ்க்கை (U.G. Krishnamurti: Oru Vaazhkkai – Tamil translation of Mahesh Bhatt's 'A Life')
description: Kannadasan Pathippagam, 2015, 384 pages, Rs 240; Tamil translation by Mu.Ki. Santhanam of Mahesh Bhatt's biography.

title: தனித்து நிற்கும் துணிவு (Thanithu Nirkum Thunivu – Tamil 'The Courage to Stand Alone')
description: Tamil edition of 'The Courage to Stand Alone' (Q&A format), reviewed in Thaaii Magazine (2024) as a book that changes one's outlook on life; listed at CommonFolks.

title: எண்ணம்தான் உங்களின் எதிரி (Ennamthan Ungalin Ethiri – Tamil 'Thought Is Your Enemy') and மனம் ஒரு புனைகதை (Manam Oru Punaikathai – Tamil 'Mind Is a Myth')
description: Further Tamil translations listed by Tamil booksellers: 'எண்ணம்தான் உங்களின் எதிரி' (Rs 80) and 'மனம் ஒரு புனைகதை'; Noolulagam has an author page for யு.ஜி. கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தி.

title: VALLALAR: யூ.ஜி.கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தி (Tamil blog post on U.G.)
description: Tamil blog profile: 'யு.ஜி.கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தி என்று அழைக்கப்படும் உப்பலுரி கோபல கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தி 1918-ஆம் ஆண்டு ... மசூலிப்பட்டணத்தில் பிறந்தவர்'.

title: மனதை ஒரு புனைவு – யு.ஜி. கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தி (Mind is a Myth Tamil – second YouTube part)
description: Another YouTube video in the Tamil 'மனதை ஒரு புனைவு' (Mind is a Myth) series.

title: ইউ জি-র সঙ্গে পাম স্প্রিং-এ চোদ্দ দিন (U.G.-r Sange Palm Spring-e Choddo Din – 'Fourteen Days with U.G. in Palm Springs')
description: Bengali book by Dr. Sabyasachi Guha, published by Ramakrishna Chattopadhyay, Hindmotor, Bengal, 2009.

title: ইউ জি কৃষ্ণমূর্তি – এক জীবন্ত কাহিনী (U.G. Krishnamurti – Ek Jibanto Kahini; Bengali translation of Mahesh Bhatt's biography)
description: Bengali translation by Dr. Sabyasachi Guha, published by Ramakrishna Chattopadhyay 2011; reissued by Deepa Prakashan, Kolkata, 2013.

title: নো ওয়ে আউট (No Way Out – Bengali translation, Dhaka)
description: Bengali translation of 'No Way Out' by Nannu Mahbub, published by Shrabon Prokashani, Dhaka, 2014 (single source).

title: યુ.જી.કૃષ્ણમુર્તિ (Gujarati Wikipedia article)
description: Gujarati Wikipedia article on U.G.; its bibliography lists Mahesh Bhatt's 'U.G. Krishnamurti: A Life' (Viking 1992), Shanta Kelkar's 'The Sage and the Housewife' (Smriti 2005) and Mukunda Rao's 'The Other Side of Belief' (Penguin 2005) in Gujarati transliteration.

title: ugkrishnamurti.in – Books About UG / Translations list (Indian-language editions)
description: Official U.G. site's bibliography of books about U.G. and translations, the main online source for Hindi, Bengali, Kannada and Telugu edition data (Vani Prakashan Hindi 1996/1997, Bengali Guha translations 2009–2013, etc.). Companion: J.C. Tsai's well.com 'Books, Interviews, and References'.

title: ವೈ.ಎನ್.ಕೃಷ್ಣಮೂರ್ತಿ (Kannada Wikipedia article on Y.N. Krishnamurthy 'YNK', U.G.'s Kannada interpreter)
description: Kannada Wikipedia describes journalist YNK (Kannada Prabha editor) as a follower of U.G. who introduced U.G.'s thought to Kannada readers; notes his popular piece/book 'ಯೂಜಿ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಗುರೂಜಿ'.

title: ಚಿಂತನ ದರ್ಶನ: ವೈಚಾರಿಕ (Kannada blog post grouping U.G. with J.K. and Osho)
description: Kannada blog essay on rationalist thinkers mentioning ಯು.ಜಿ. ಕೃಷ್ಣಮೂರ್ತಿ alongside J. Krishnamurti and Osho.

title: UG Aradhana meet, 'Hridaya Vihar', Bangalore, 22 March 2018 (11th death-anniversary gathering)
description: Blog report by the Bangalore 'UG Friends' group on the annual aradhana (death anniversary) gathering at Hridaya Vihar, Bangalore, on 22 March 2018; the same blog carries K. Chandrasekhar posts and 'The Best of UG'. No Machilipatnam/Gudivada centenary event found online.

title: Telugu/Tamil film-world kin: actresses Gautami and Soumya Bollapragada as U.G.'s close relatives
description: English Wikipedia notes South Indian actresses Gautami and Soumya Bollapragada are U.G.'s close relatives; Telugu Wikipedia names Soumya Bollapragada as his granddaughter. The only film-industry link found; no Telugu/Kannada film or TV depiction of U.G. located.

title: Arth (1982, Hindi film) – ending reportedly suggested by U.G. to Mahesh Bhatt
description: Mahesh Bhatt's biography states the last scene of 'Arth', where the heroine walks away alone from husband and lover, was suggested and insisted upon by U.G. – the main Indian-cinema reference to U.G.

title: …என்றார் யூ.ஜி.கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தி ('…said U.G. Krishnamurti' – Solvanam Tamil web magazine article)
description: Tamil literary web magazine Solvanam's 2020 essay on U.G.'s sayings; notes he was unrelated to J. Krishnamurti.
